name: Entity
description: A person, animal, object, place, event, idea, or category that can be referred to as an entity; not a lexical action or quality.

name: Physical entity
description: An entity that has a physical location or extent.

name: Animate entity
description: A living person or animal whose existence normally uses いる, excluding plants and inanimate representations.

name: Person
description: A human being, human role, group of humans, or personal reference.

name: Animal
description: A nonhuman animal, including pets, normally located with いる.

name: Physical object
description: A tangible inanimate object; excludes people, animals, events, and abstract properties.

name: Portable object
description: An inanimate physical object normally movable or carried by a person.

name: Flat object
description: A thin flat item naturally counted with 枚, such as paper, tickets, or clothing; not a volume or long cylindrical item.

name: Food
description: A substance or dish ordinarily eaten as food in this entry’s meaning; excludes beverages.

name: Beverage
description: A liquid ordinarily drunk as a beverage in this entry’s meaning.

name: Readable material
description: A document, publication, message, or other linguistic material that can naturally be read.

name: Writable content
description: Text, a document, a character, or other content that can naturally be written.

name: Body part
description: A part or bodily feature of a person or animal, including height and hair.

name: Place
description: A location, region, building, room, or spatial area usable as an action location or destination.

name: Container
description: An object or bounded space with an interior that can hold suitable smaller objects.

name: Event
description: An occurrence or organized event located in time, such as a meeting, test, or party.

name: Human role
description: An occupation, social role, student status, or other identity that can classify a person.

name: Activity noun
description: A noun naming an activity or practice, including productive する nouns when applicable.

name: Suru activity noun
description: An activity noun that can form its corresponding activity verb by directly appending する.

name: Language
description: A natural language used to communicate, such as Japanese or English.

name: Tool
description: An instrument or device that can be used to perform an action.

name: Transport
description: A vehicle or conveyance usable as a means of transport, rather than a destination.

name: Occasion
description: An event or customary occasion, such as a meal or celebration, for which an action can be performed.

name: Color noun
description: A noun naming a color that modifies another noun with の, rather than an adjective with its own attributive form.

name: Time expression
description: An expression locating an event in time or describing temporal extent.

name: Specific time
description: A specific clock time, weekday, date, or calendar time that naturally takes に when locating an action.

name: Relative time
description: An expression such as today, tomorrow, this morning, or every day that normally locates an action without に.

name: Clock time
description: An already complete clock-time expression including the hour and any minutes, not an unbound counter suffix.

name: Duration
description: An already complete length-of-time expression that measures an activity, not a clock time or bare counter suffix.

name: Cardinal number
description: A standalone numeral denoting a cardinal quantity that can combine with an appropriate counter, not a date, rank, or numeral already containing a counter.

name: Affirmative frequency adverb
description: An adverb such as often, sometimes, or usually that naturally modifies an affirmative habitual predicate.

name: Negative frequency adverb
description: An adverb such as あまり or 全然 that requires a negative predicate for the intended not-often or not-at-all reading.

name: Relative location noun
description: A spatial relation such as above, below, front, behind, inside, or beside that forms reference noun + の + location noun.

name: Demonstrative object pronoun
description: A standalone object demonstrative equivalent to this one, that one, or that one over there; excludes the interrogative and adnominal series.

name: Demonstrative noun modifier
description: A demonstrative directly preceding a noun, equivalent to this or that; excludes standalone demonstratives and interrogatives.

name: Demonstrative location
description: A standalone locative demonstrative meaning here, there, or over there; excludes the interrogative where.

name: Preference
description: A quality expressing liking or disliking, taking the liked thing or activity with が.

name: Skill level
description: A quality expressing skill or lack of skill at an activity, taking that activity with が.

name: Gradable quality
description: An adjective whose intended meaning can coherently vary in degree and be compared; excludes strictly categorical qualities.

name: Physical quality
description: An adjective describing a perceivable physical property of objects, places, or bodily features.

name: Adjectival color
description: An adjective expressing a color, with the adjective’s normal attributive morphology.

name: Temporal quality
description: An adjective whose adverbial form can naturally express early or late timing of an action.

name: Action or occurrence
description: A verb naming an action, change, state, or occurrence.

name: Voluntary action
description: An action that an intentional participant can normally choose to perform; suitable for invitations, intentions, requests, or wants.

name: Object-taking action
description: In the entry’s stated meaning, a verb accepts a direct object marked を; excludes motion-path を unless separately modeled.

name: Objectless action
description: In the entry’s stated meaning, a verb can form a complete ordinary predicate without an explicit direct object or destination; do not select verbs requiring an omitted complement to make sense.

name: Motion to a destination
description: A motion verb that naturally combines with a destination marked に or へ, such as go, come, or return.

name: Durative activity
description: An activity whose te-form + いる ordinarily describes an action in progress, rather than only a resulting state.

name: Resulting-state verb
description: A verb whose te-form + いる naturally describes a state resulting from an earlier change, such as being married, holding, wearing, or having gone.

name: Residence verb
description: A verb used with a location marked に to express residing in that location, normally as a resulting or continuing state.

name: Eating action
description: A verb meaning to eat or consume solid food in the entry’s stated meaning.

name: Drinking action
description: A verb meaning to drink a beverage in the entry’s stated meaning.

name: Reading action
description: A verb meaning to read linguistic material in the entry’s stated meaning.

name: Writing action
description: A verb meaning to write textual content in the entry’s stated meaning.

name: Meeting action
description: A verb meaning meet or see a person, with that person marked に.

name: Communication action
description: A verb meaning communicate or converse and permitting the language to be marked で.

name: Opinion thinking
description: A verb meaning think or believe that accepts a finite proposition marked と as its content; it must fit the Genki opinion construction.

name: Quoted speech reporting
description: A speech verb meaning say or state that accepts a proposition marked と and whose te-form + いました can report the earlier statement.

name: Becoming a state
description: A change-of-state verb equivalent to なる that accepts the resulting noun or na-adjective with に, or an i-adjective with く.

name: Indefinite thing
description: A standalone expression meaning something or anything, equivalent to 何か, without an added case particle.

name: Already
description: An aspectual adverb equivalent to もう that marks the prior completion of an event, not a degree word or additional quantity.

name: Not yet
description: An aspectual adverb equivalent to まだ that, with a negative progressive, marks noncompletion with an expectation of completion.

name: Most
description: An adverb equivalent to いちばん that marks the maximum degree of a quality within a comparison set.

name: Which of two
description: An interrogative equivalent to どちら that asks which of two compared choices satisfies a predicate.
